instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/cli_plate.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job and a top Face operation. Set the Job origin at the stock top-face center. Use T1 to target final top Z=10.000 mm with S6000 rpm and F750 mm/min. Tool definition: T1 is a face mill, S6000 rpm, F750 mm/min. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-01.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
